name: Common Port Service Lookup
description: Look up common TCP and UDP port numbers and their commonly associated services.
search_intent: Find the common service or purpose associated with a TCP or UDP port number.
calculation: Validate integer port 0 through 65535. Search a curated local reference table for the selected TCP/UDP protocol and port. If no curated service match exists, report that no common entry is included rather than inventing a service. Also classify the numeric port range.
limitations: A port number does not prove which application is actually using it.
The reference should focus on common assignments rather than pretending to reproduce every registered service.
This tool performs no network scan or connection attempt.
